metadata.benchmark_name: CS614 System C RQ3 Inference Economics Ablation

fixed_1hop.label: Fixed 1-Hop Baseline
fixed_1hop.description: Standard single-pass retrieval (lower latency bound; lacks multi-hop depth).

fixed_3hop.label: Fixed 3-Hop Exhaustive
fixed_3hop.description: Naive iterative multi-hop without early-stopping (upper cost & latency bound).

adaptive_v1.label: Adaptive Multi-Hop (AMR v1)
adaptive_v1.description: System C v1 with Evidence Sufficiency Critic dynamic early-stopping.

agentic_v2.label: Agentic Adaptive (AAMR v2)
agentic_v2.description: System C v2 with autonomous tabular XBRL tool + dynamic early-stopping.
